operations.summary_zh: 读取通知发送运行时健康状态
operations.description: Outbox worker state with each channel's state, the account flow senders and the last settings rebuild. Reasons and errors are fixed codes and never contain a server address, account name or secret. Also served as the notification member of GET /health/detail. Notification state never makes GET /health/ready fail in the auto mode.

fields.name: state
fields.type: string: disabled / built / running / ready / backoff / stopping / stopped / failed

fields.name: mode
fields.description: NOTIFICATION_RUNTIME_ENABLED: true (explicit), unset/auto/false (auto, follows the system settings without a restart) or off.

fields.name: account_senders
fields.description: Auto mode. Senders of the account flows, rebuilt with the outbox worker.

fields.name: last_rebuild_error
fields.description: Auto mode. Error code of the last rebuild (settings_unreadable, worker_start_failed, <flow>_unavailable); absent when it succeeded.
